scope: all15 known clips; every coarse frame and every frozen v06 core ref, excluding self; full core-core pairs included; prioritize main92 frames/all44 conflicts14 unresolved but do not omit remaining frames or negatives

interpretation: five explicit competing hypotheses: within-ID mixed cores, duplicate IDs, shared/common background, real view-transition, unknown. None proven by overlap alone. No-match never different scene. No feature training or VLM
